job: Show or enter a secret that stays masked until asked.
purpose: Keys and signing secrets stay masked until someone asks. Reveal swaps in the real value, copy confirms with a check, and rotate hands the decision to your app (fd:rotate; set the new value with setSecret). Copy always copies the real value. With data-mode="entry" it is a password-style input for typing a new secret: no stored value, no copy, and it masks again on submit.
useWhen: An API key or signing secret is shown with reveal and copy.
A person types a new password or key (data-mode="entry").
A key must be rotated from the page.

avoidWhen.when: The value is not sensitive and only needs copying.
A command or snippet is copied from a code block.
A one-time code is typed in.
The secret is shown once on creation.

states.name: copied
states.how: data-state="copied" for a moment after copy

variants.useWhen: Keep the first and last eight characters so keys stay recognisable.
Show the start and the last few characters, masked even with no reveal button.
Type a new secret in a form.
Draw attention to a key shown once after creating it.

parts.role: The wrapper; carries data-fd-secret and data-value.
The part that shortens with an ellipsis.
The part that is never cut off.
The password input in entry mode.
The reveal, copy and rotate buttons (data-fd-field-action).

keyboard.does: On reveal, copy or rotate: runs the action.
